DIAGNOSIS READY: Bronchiectasis

The description of "copious amounts of thick, foamy, yellow-green sputum" that is worse in the morning, combined with recurrent bronchitis and a non-smoking history, is highly suggestive of bronchiectasis. The Chest_CT images I requested will confirm this diagnosis by showing dilated bronchi.
